item.desc: After years of living in China, I’ve honestly come to see street food as better than restaurant food most of the time. Of course there are exceptions, but the best street vendors usually have a personal stake in every dish they serve. They’re cooking the same handful of specialties day after day, refining them over years, sometimes decades. There’s a sense of pride and care that’s hard to replicate in a larger restaurant. And beyond the food itself, there’s something deeply satisfying about eating on the street. No fancy décor, no presentation tricks—just great food, fresh air, and everyday life happening around you. It feels more honest, more connected to the place and the people who live there. Restaurants can offer comfort and occasion, but street food often offers something rarer: authenticity. #china #chinesefood #streetfood #familytime #chinalife
